name: Tooltip
purpose: Displays supplementary information for a control on hover or focus.
scenarios: Explain an icon button on hover
Show a keyboard shortcut on focus
Provide a hint for a form field

trigger.description: Element that opens the tooltip on hover or focus.

openDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before the tooltip opens.

closeDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before the tooltip closes.

antiPatterns: Do not put essential instructions only in a tooltip.
Do not open a tooltip from a touch event without an alternative control.

keyboard: Focus the trigger to show the tooltip
a11y.focus: Tooltip follows the trigger focus and pointer hover.
a11y.labeling: Tooltip content is associated with the trigger via aria-describedby.

responsive.strategy: Tooltip stays within the viewport and avoids clipping on compact screens.

breakpoints.compact: Tooltip is not the primary touch interaction; an explicit control is preferred.
breakpoints.medium: Tooltip appears on hover and focus.
breakpoints.large: Tooltip appears on hover and focus.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Tooltip positioning follows the document direction.
